name: VinSolutions Connect CRM
description_en:
VinSolutions Connect CRM is a product in the CRM category. Its directory profile covers Customer Support, Marketing Automation, Lead Scoring, Call Logging, Contact Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: organize customer questions and service interactions; coordinate triggered marketing activities and recurring campaigns; prioritize prospective customers using defined attributes and activity; record calls and related notes for later follow-up; store and organize people, organizations and their contact details. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：整理客户问题与服务沟通记录；组织按条件触发的营销活动与周期性推广；按线索属性和互动记录确定跟进优先级；记录通话及备注以便后续跟进；集中保存和整理联系人、组织及其联系方式。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
